text:
You know the worst part (aside from looking ugly) is that ads on nhl uniforms are purely due to greed and profit.

Some fans online and in this sub have been endlessly mocking European teams for jersey ads and I’m not the one to defend them, they look ugly. But across Europe the teams neeed the sponsorships to survive as they finance their own hockey academies and youth programs and some of them have to pay rent for the arenas they play in. Factor in the smaller stadiums and less revenue from tickets and broadcasting rights and jersey ads are a matter of necessity for the teams

But in NHL I feel like there was zero reason to keep ads on jerseys and helmets. And yet they did it. We can only wish we won’t get a second jersey ad anytime soon
